answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, but coordinated equivocation across k linked identities triggers O(k²) slashing, with cross-evidence amplifying the loss beyond any single fault. Detection of a sybil swarm applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, making replication economically irrational: a walnut-sized operator cannot wander through aliases or hide behind a sonnet of fabricated attestations without risking systemic depletion.
